items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: We don't publish prices because scope sets the number. What is fixed: you get a written proposal with a closed price before signing, and that number doesn't move. If you ask for something outside the scope mid-project, it's quoted separately and also in writing.

items.q: Do you only build Empretienda or Tiendanube stores?
items.a: No. Our core is custom development from scratch: apps, systems and stores made exactly for your business. If you already use a platform such as Tiendanube, Empretienda, Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress or Mercado Libre, we work with it too. We also run Meta, Google and Mercado Libre ads, and cover AI, cybersecurity and infrastructure.

items.q: Do you work with Mercado Libre?
items.a: Yes. We set up and organize your seller account, optimize your listings and run Mercado Libre Ads campaigns. If you also have your own store, we connect both channels so they grow together.
Detailed scope, stages with delivery dates, fixed price, payment terms and the post-delivery warranty with its term. You read it before signing and keep a copy.
Any error or fault in what we delivered: we fix it free of charge during the warranty period set in the contract. It does not cover new features or scope changes, which are quoted separately.
Yes. We're a registered company and we invoice every payment on the project. You have proper documentation from start to finish.

items.q: How does communication work during the project?
items.a: You have a direct line to whoever is building, not a generic inbox. Every stage closes with something working that you can open and test yourself.

items.q: Can I see something you've built?
items.a: Yes, and without asking. The portfolio projects are online right now: go in, browse the catalog, add something to the cart. None of them is a mockup.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Argentina?
items.a: Yes. We work fully remote with documented processes, so distance doesn't change how we work. Invoicing and payment terms are agreed before signing.

items.q: Do you publish apps on the App Store and Google Play?
items.a: Yes. We hold verified developer accounts and handle the whole publishing process: listings, screenshots, privacy forms, signed builds and updates.

items.q: Do you cover infrastructure, servers and security?
items.a: Yes — it's a division of its own. Software architecture, Docker, AWS, VPS, networking, CI/CD, monitoring and ongoing maintenance, plus cybersecurity audits, hardening, backups and certificates. We can run your entire infrastructure or work alongside your current provider.
In Baradero, Buenos Aires, Argentina. Several of our clients are local businesses that know us in person, and we work remotely with companies across the country and abroad.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses or only companies?
items.a: Both. The portfolio ranges from a 24/7 convenience store and clothing shops to a factory with 40 years of history. The criterion isn't size: it's a clear problem worth solving.

termsBlocks.p: PotenciApp is a software development company registered in Argentina, based in Baradero, Buenos Aires. Contact: contacto@potenciapp.com · WhatsApp +54 9 3329 613035.

Every project is formalised through a contract signed by both parties before work starts, defining scope, milestones, delivery dates, fixed price and payment terms. Requests outside the agreed scope are quoted separately and in writing. We issue a legal invoice for every payment.

Deliverables carry a post-delivery warranty whose term is set in each project's contract, covering free correction of errors or faults in what we built. It does not cover new features, scope changes, or failures caused by third-party modifications, misuse or external services.

Unless the contract states otherwise, once the project is paid in full the client receives the source code and the accounts for contracted services in their own name (domain, hosting, store accounts).

The content of potenciapp.com is informational and does not constitute a contractual offer: the conditions applicable to each project are exclusively those of the signed contract. Client names and brands shown belong to their owners and are displayed as references of delivered work.

privacyBlocks.p: This site uses no tracking cookies and no analytics tools. We only receive the data you send us voluntarily: what you write in the site chat, on WhatsApp or by email (typically your name, contact details and project description).

The site assistant is powered by artificial intelligence (Google Gemini). Messages you write in the chat are sent to Google's API to generate the reply and are not stored by us in any database of our own. Do not write passwords, card details or sensitive information in the chat.
Exclusively to reply to you, prepare proposals and deliver contracted projects. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.
You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete the data you sent us by writing to contacto@potenciapp.com. Billing-related data is kept for as long as Argentine law requires.

confianza.metaTitle: Before hiring us: contract, tax ID, warranty and references | PotenciApp
confianza.metaDescription: The 9 things you should demand from whoever builds your website or system, answered one by one: legal name and tax ID, contract, domain in your name, access, code ownership, costs, warranty, staged payments and references.
confianza.title: Everything you should demand from whoever builds your website.
confianza.intro: Ask an AI, an accountant or a friend what to require from a software vendor and the list is always the same. Here we answer it point by point, before you have to ask.
confianza.identityPending: Legal name and tax ID: ask us on WhatsApp and we send them right away, before any payment.
confianza.warranty: The post-delivery warranty is {days} days and is written in the contract.
confianza.warrantyPending: The post-delivery warranty has a fixed term written in every contract.

items.ask: Legal name, tax ID and an invoice for every payment.
items.answer: {identity} We issue an electronic invoice for every payment, to your business or to you. You can verify the tax ID on the official registration certificate before paying.

items.ask: A signed contract with scope, final price and delivery date.
items.answer: No project starts without a contract signed by both parties. It sets a detailed scope, dated stages, a fixed price, payment terms and the warranty. We send you the contract template on WhatsApp before you pay anything, so you can review it with whoever you like.

items.ask: Domain registered in my name or my business's name.
items.answer: The domain is registered in your name, at NIC Argentina or the relevant registrar, from day one. If you already own it, we work on your account. It is never held by PotenciApp.

items.ask: My own access to hosting, the admin panel and linked accounts.
items.answer: On delivery you receive the credentials for hosting, admin panel, domain, payment gateway and any account created for the project, and we recommend changing the passwords that same day. If you prefer, accounts are created in your name from the start.

items.ask: Written confirmation of who owns the design, code and content.
items.answer: You do. Once the project is paid in full, the source code, design and content are your property, as the contract and our terms state. You can take it to another vendor whenever you want.

items.ask: A breakdown of renewal, hosting and maintenance costs.
items.answer: The proposal separates the project price from recurring costs: domain, hosting, certificates and third-party services, each with its amount and frequency. Maintenance is optional and contracted separately; nothing ties you to us.

items.ask: A written warranty and support procedure.
items.answer: {warranty} During that term we fix any error or fault in what we delivered free of charge. You report on WhatsApp or email, we confirm receipt and tell you when it will be resolved. It does not cover new features or scope changes, which are quoted separately.

items.ask: Staged payments tied to verifiable deliveries.
items.answer: We never ask for the full amount up front. There is a deposit on signing and the rest is paid against stages you can open and test yourself, with the final balance against the production release. Percentages and dates are in the proposal.

items.ask: At least two real clients willing to give a reference.
items.answer: Ask for two and we share the contact of clients with delivered projects, with their permission. You can also open any live site in our portfolio and write to that business yourself.

confianza.ctaTitle: Ask us for all of it in one message.
confianza.ctaBody: Tap the button and we reply with the contract template, invoicing details and two references.
confianza.waMessage: Hi PotenciApp, I am considering hiring you. Could you send me the contract template, legal name and tax ID, two client references, and how you handle the domain, access, warranty and staged payments?

faq.q: Do you meet in person in Baradero?
faq.a: Yes. We are in Baradero and arrange in-person meetings on WhatsApp, for the initial assessment as well as deliveries and training. We also work over video call if that suits you better.

faq.q: How much does a website cost in Baradero?
faq.a: It depends on what your business needs: a presentation site is not the same as an online store or a system. The assessment is free and you leave with a written proposal with scope, dates and a fixed price that does not move.

faq.q: Do you work with small businesses?
faq.a: Yes. Kiosks, clothing stores, refrigeration, furniture makers and schools from the area are in our portfolio. We size the project to your business, with a contract and invoice just like a large company.

faq.q: Which do I need: a website or an online store?
faq.a: If you want to be found and contacted, a website with WhatsApp is enough. If you want to sell with payments and shipping without handling every order by hand, a store. We define it together in the assessment.

faq.q: Do you work with clients in San Pedro, Zárate, Campana or San Antonio de Areco?
faq.a: Yes. We serve the whole north of Buenos Aires province, in person or remotely, as well as clients across the country and abroad.
